profile: CRISPR Therapeutics develops CRISPR-based gene-editing therapeutics for serious diseases. Its programs span hemoglobin disorders, in vivo gene editing, gene-edited CAR T cell therapies and regenerative medicine. Its approved therapy CASGEVY treats eligible patients with sickle cell disease or transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia and is developed and commercialized with Vertex. The company also advances delivery and gene-editing technologies.
